review.imagery: Eleven distinct native-resolution project renders from the Wasl-branded portal-hosted brochure were visually reviewed. Card and hero use the complete development aerial. Living and bedroom scenes are retained as proposed project interiors. Current primary-page images were also reviewed, with duplicated frontage and the generic mosque icon excluded. No dated construction photograph was established. No card badges.
review.floorPlans: All 33 original H1 sheets remain complete. H1 layouts do not establish identical H2/H3 homes. The 1 BR E sheet labels its table C. The 3 BR A terrace units disagree, 3 BR C swaps total columns, and the 4 BR drawing repeats a 3 BR table. Those areas remain disputed or unverified. Whole duplex totals apply once. Other source rounding and summary conflicts require Wasl confirmation. All 12 unit sheets and visible numeric panels were reviewed at 3200 pixels, including every published multilevel drawing. All 21 H1 building floorplates were checked for source building/level scope. Physical pages 42 and 43 both label Building B level 2 and remain identified by physical page. No area is inferred for corrupted tables or for a complete building floorplate. Source branding and notices remain intact.
review.location: Original brochure pages 6 and 58 were visually reviewed. The masterplan separates all three clusters and the regional page publishes eight wider-community estimates. No project-specific published pin was established on the current guide, so named directions are retained without borrowed neighbouring coordinates.
review.provenance: The ordinary-GET official HTML, original portal-hosted PDF, hashes, full source sheets and native image resources are cached. Property Finder hosting remains explicit. Source conflicts, commercial qualifications and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: A verified visitor-entrance coordinate, dated construction photographs, corrected disputed layout areas and equivalent individual H2/H3 unit packs were not established.
